svg.title: Caught by the dusk
svg.desc: Caught by the dusk, after Eddie Colfox's 2001 flight in Hunza. A section through deep Karakoram valleys late in the day: the pilot still high in sunlight, the valleys below already in shadow, the known landing beach by the river out of reach, and the narrow strip above a gully where he had to land: a four-metre strip, by a stone wall. Schematic.
svg.text: known landing: a beach by the river
landed short, on a four-metre strip
above a gully, by a stone wall
